messages:
Maya Lopez: Heads up 1 need to shift the embargo from 4/6 to 4/7 due to late legal review. Can we still run analyst briefings on 4/5/6 as planned?
Jason Park: Oof. embargo shift ok but need to notify top-tier press asap. do we have a list of folks who requested embargo exceptions? some outlets asked for earlier access.
Elena Ruiz: We have two analysts who asked for early hands-on (Forrester/IDC) 1 they requested access to Dedicated cluster. We can offer pre-brief code access under NDA.
Marco Tan: NDA + gating is fine. infra can provision a 24h sandbox on Dedicated if Legal signs the standard research NDA. who's owning the request?
Nina Rao: I'll own provisioning. need lead contact and NDA status. @Elena send me firms + contacts, I'll queue infra tickets.
Elena Ruiz: sending list now: Forrester - Claire M., IDC - Tomas K. Both asked about quantization and cost numbers.
Maya Lopez: Important: any early access must be explicitly excluded from embargo. Press must not publish before 4/7. Analysts can get early access if they agree to embargo terms.
pressops-bot: Embargo change recorded: old=2026-04-06T17:00:00Z new=2026-04-07T17:00:00Z. Notify channel: #marketing.
Jason Park: Draft notification: "Due to a scheduling update, embargo moved to 4/7 17:00Z. We will host targeted analyst briefings on 4/5-4/6. Media invites for exec briefing remain 4/7 16:00Z PT (embargo lift 17:00Z). Contact press@redwood-inference.com for exceptions." Thoughts?
Maya Lopez: solid. tighten: remove exact internal times for targeted briefings in public invite. keep exec briefing time.
Elena Ruiz: Also need approved quote for analyst packet about benchmarks. Current line: "up to 35% lower per-token cost in typical LLM mixes" Legal flagged the "up to" and wants backup.
legal-bot: Reminder: All performance claims require a linked methodology and approval from Research. Percentages must be accompanied by test conditions.
Marco Tan: Research will produce a short appendix. We're comfortable with 35% for batch-optimized scenarios. Send the appendix link with the packet.
Nina Rao: For sandbox access we'll attach the technical runbook and the ticket id. infra will rotate creds after sandbox expiry.
Jason Park: I'll update the press kit with the appendix link and a one-line methodology pointer. Also add a fact-check contact and a link to the embargo terms doc.
Maya Lopez: Next: who is the spokesperson for analyst infra questions? Marco or Sanjay?
Elena Ruiz: Marco can do the opening 15m, then hand off to Sanjay for deep infra Qs. Analysts prefer the signal->deep dive format.
Maya Lopez: Great. final checklist: legal sign-off on numbers (EOD), research appendix link, NDA for sandbox, infra tickets created, press note updated. Can we get green by tomorrow morning?
Marco Tan: We can. Research will deliver appendix by EOD.
Nina Rao: provisioning queued. ETA 8h after NDA receipt.
Elena Ruiz: I'll confirm analyst attendees and send calendar holds once legal confirms.
pressops-bot: Action items logged: legal_review, research_appendix, infra_provision, press_update.
Maya Lopez: Thanks team 1 once legal clears I'll blast invites and lock the briefing roster. :thumbsup:
